title: Use and Bulk Regulations on Receiving Sites
previewText:
The use and bulk regulations applicable to a receiving site shall be modified as follows:

(a) C6-4 Districts Within Area A2 on the maps in the Appendix to this Chapter, the use and bulk regulations of the underlying C6-4 District shall not apply. blocks.html: The use and bulk regulations applicable to a receiving site shall be modified as follows:
blocks.plainText: The use and bulk regulations applicable to a receiving site shall be modified as follows:

blocks.html:
(a)        C6-4 Districts

Within Area A2 on the maps in the Appendix to this Chapter, the use and bulk regulations of the underlying C6-4 District shall not apply. In lieu thereof, the use and bulk regulations of an M1-5 District shall apply.

Within Area B-R1 and Area B-R2, the use and bulk regulations of the underlying C6-4X District shall not apply. In lieu thereof, the use and bulk regulations of an M2-3 District shall apply.
blocks.plainText: (a) C6-4 Districts Within Area A2 on the maps in the Appendix to this Chapter, the use and bulk regulations of the underlying C6-4 District shall not apply. In lieu thereof, the use and bulk regulations of an M1-5 District shall apply. Within Area B-R1 and Area B-R2, the use and bulk regulations of the underlying C6-4X District shall not apply. In lieu thereof, the use and bulk regulations of an M2-3 District shall apply.

blocks.html:
(b)        C6-3 and M1-5 Districts

The use and bulk regulations of the underlying C6-3 and M1-5 Districts shall not apply. In lieu thereof, the use and bulk regulations of an M2-4 District shall apply.
blocks.plainText: (b) C6-3 and M1-5 Districts The use and bulk regulations of the underlying C6-3 and M1-5 Districts shall not apply. In lieu thereof, the use and bulk regulations of an M2-4 District shall apply.

blocks.html:
(c)        C4-7 Districts in Area B-R3

The use and bulk regulations of the underlying C4-7 District shall not apply. In lieu thereof, the use and bulk regulations of an M2-3 District shall apply.
blocks.plainText: (c) C4-7 Districts in Area B-R3 The use and bulk regulations of the underlying C4-7 District shall not apply. In lieu thereof, the use and bulk regulations of an M2-3 District shall apply.

blocks.html:
(d)        C4-7 Districts in Area B-R4

The use and bulk regulations of the underlying C4-7 District shall not apply. In lieu thereof, the use and bulk regulations of an M2-4 District shall apply.
blocks.plainText: (d) C4-7 Districts in Area B-R4 The use and bulk regulations of the underlying C4-7 District shall not apply. In lieu thereof, the use and bulk regulations of an M2-4 District shall apply.

blocks.html: However, on a receiving site, for any development, enlargement or conversion that is the subject of a special permit granted by the City Planning Commission pursuant to Section 89-21 (Transfer of Floor Area From Hudson River Park), the use and bulk regulations of the underlying C4-7, C6-3, C6-4 or M1-5 District shall apply to such approved development, enlargement or conversion. However, in C4-7 Districts, automobile dealers and all other motor vehicle dealers, as listed in Use Group VI, may include these additional uses only: repair services or preparation of vehicles for delivery.
blocks.plainText: However, on a receiving site, for any development, enlargement or conversion that is the subject of a special permit granted by the City Planning Commission pursuant to Section 89-21 (Transfer of Floor Area From Hudson River Park), the use and bulk regulations of the underlying C4-7, C6-3, C6-4 or M1-5 District shall apply to such approved development, enlargement or conversion. However, in C4-7 Districts, automobile dealers and all other motor vehicle dealers, as listed in Use Group VI, may include these additional uses only: repair services or preparation of vehicles for delivery.

amendmentHistory.projectName: Dewitt Clinton Park North (801 Eleventh Avenue)
amendmentHistory.notes: Amended pursuant to Dewitt Clinton Park North - 801 Eleventh Avenue (N260014ZRM) to modify the regulations of the Special Hudson River Park District, define new granting and receiving sites within the special district, modify the use and bulk regulations for sites within C4-7 districts in the special district, modify the regulations of the Special Clinton District to reconcile the Special Clinton District with the Special Hudson River Park District, and designate a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing (MIH) area on the receiving site that is subject to the requested actions
